compendium.summary: Two-way language access for negotiations and mixed-language operations. More useful than Comprehend Languages when an ally must communicate, not merely understand.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: The 2024 version covers spoken and signed communication. It is an hour-long, non-concentration effect, so it can support a social scene without replacing your control spell.
It does not force cooperation, truthfulness or a favorable reaction; nor does it replace literacy or solve every coded message. Usually copy and prepare for the mission.
